title: Mystic Apothecary Witch
description: A woman with purple hair in an elegant dark blue Victorian dress stands at a stone counter in a magical study, carefully mixing ingredients with a glass vial. The room is filled with glowing green potion bottles, scrolls, an open spellbook, a crystal ball with purple mist, and arcane paintings on a starry night wall with a large arched window showing a full moon.
prompt: A beautiful witch with purple hair tied in an updo stands in her mystical apothecary at night, wearing a high-collared dark blue Victorian dress. She carefully pours liquid from a small vial into another container. Her stone workbench is covered with glowing green potion jars, scrolls, an open glowing spellbook, and a large crystal ball emitting purple mist under a glass dome. Behind her is a tall arched window with a full moon, red curtains, floating magical geometric crystals, and framed arcane paintings on a starry wall.
